name: open-generative-ai
description: AI Video Agency — Professional AI-powered video editing studio with image, video, cinema and lip sync capabilities

scripts.build:all: npm run build:remix-go && npm run build:ai-vfx && npm run build:vibe-workflow && npm run build:videco-ai-platform && npm run build:ai-headshot-generator && npm run build:marketing-studio && npm run build:workflows && npm run build:agents && npm run build
scripts.build:remix-go: pnpm --filter remix-go run build && mkdir -p public/apps/remix-go && cp -r apps/remix-go/dist/* public/apps/remix-go/
scripts.build:vibe-workflow: pnpm --filter vibe-workflow run build && mkdir -p public/apps/vibe-workflow && cp -r apps/vibe-workflow/dist/* public/apps/vibe-workflow/
scripts.build:videco-ai-platform: pnpm --filter videco-ai-platform run build && mkdir -p public/apps/videco-ai-platform && cp -r apps/videco-ai-platform/dist/* public/apps/videco-ai-platform/
scripts.build:ai-headshot-generator: pnpm --filter ai-headshot-generator run build && mkdir -p public/apps/ai-headshot-generator && cp -r apps/ai-headshot-generator/dist/* public/apps/ai-headshot-generator/
scripts.demo:full: npm run demo:create && npm run demo:view
scripts.build:marketing-studio: pnpm --filter marketing-studio run build && mkdir -p public/apps/marketing-studio && cp -r apps/marketing-studio/dist/* public/apps/marketing-studio/
scripts.build:workflows: pnpm --filter workflows run build && mkdir -p public/apps/workflows && cp -r apps/workflows/dist/* public/apps/workflows/
scripts.build:agents: pnpm --filter agents run build && mkdir -p public/apps/agents && cp -r apps/agents/dist/* public/apps/agents/
